description: A sheet of ply screwed to the wall and painted over every season, so the old numbers stand up through the new ones in low relief: a decade of standings you can read with your fingertips. The current column is chalk. Names get abbreviated to whatever survives being shouted across a room: DUTCH, LOTTIE, VESS, and a fourth that has been scratched out and rewritten so many times the ply has given up. At the bottom, in paint, in a hand that meant it: THE SLAG DOESN'T CARE WHO YOU WERE.
name: the tally board
